title: Human Motion Prediction via Continual Prior Compensation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human Motion Prediction (HMP) aims to predict future human poses at different moments according to observed past motion sequences. Previous approaches mainly treated the prediction of different temporal moments as a single prediction task and learned the predictions of varied moments simultaneously, which would encounter a main limitation: the learning of short-term predictions (referring to ``near-future'' prediction) could be hindered by the predictions of long-term (referring to ``far-future'' prediction) motions. In this paper, we develop a novel temporal continual learning framework called Continual Prior Compensation (CPC) to progressively train HMP models, in which we divide the prediction task of motions corresponding to varied temporal moments into several subtasks and train the model in a multi-stage manner. translated_title: 基于持续先验补偿的人体运动预测
translated_abstract: 人体运动预测（HMP）旨在根据观察到的过去运动序列，预测未来不同时刻的人体姿态。以往的方法主要将不同时间时刻的预测视为单一的预测任务，并同时学习各个时刻的预测，这会遇到一个主要局限：短期预测（即“近期未来”预测）的学习可能受到长期（即“远期未来”）运动预测的阻碍。在本文中，我们开发了一种新颖的时间持续学习框架，称为持续先验补偿（CPC），以渐进式地训练HMP模型。在该框架中，我们将对应于不同时间时刻的运动预测任务划分为若干子任务，并以多阶段的方式训练模型。为了缓解渐进式训练过程中的先验信息遗忘问题，我们进一步引入了一个可学习的随机变……
tldr: 提出了一种持续先验补偿（CPC）框架，将不同时刻的人体运动预测任务分解为多个子任务并进行多阶段渐进式训练，同时通过可学习的随机变量补偿先验信息遗忘，从而避免短期预测的学习受到长期预测的干扰。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Continual Prior Compensation (CPC) framework that decomposes human motion prediction into multiple temporal subtasks trained progressively in a multi-stage manner, using learnable random variables to compensate for prior information forgetting, thereby preventing short-term predictions from being hindered by long-term ones.
